_comment_reuseAuthState: false on purpose: reuse logs in with a SEPARATE browser, saves storageState, closes it, then opens a second browser for the iteration. With a single iteration that reuse saves nothing and just shows two windows. false => the orchestrator skips auth setup, the iteration keeps its own context, and step 5 logs in inline. Set back to true if this feature ever runs many iterations across workers, and delete step 5 when you do.
